_about: Shared fixtures that hold order-syncer's copy of the tax destination and jurisdiction key in step with tax-calculator's (SB3-238, ADR-012). tax-calculator runs them against TaxOrchestratorService.extractCustomerAddress and createAddressKey (tax-calculator/test/unit/services/jurisdiction-parity.spec.js); order-syncer runs them against orderDestinationForCalculation and jurisdictionKey (order-syncer/test/unit/validators/jurisdiction-parity.spec.js). Change both functions and these fixtures together. Addresses under 'keys' are Stripe-shaped (postal_code); addresses under 'destinations' are commercetools-shaped (postalCode). 'stamps' names the line-item metadata tax-calculator writes on every calculation and order-syncer binds on: 'cart' carries the cart id, 'shipping' the shipping key in Multiple mode; tax-calculator asserts its request builders write them, order-syncer that its binding reads them.

keys.name: no state, echoed by Stripe as null
no state, omitted as commercetools does
lower case, surrounding spaces and a postcode with an inner space
country only (a cart with no delivery address)

destinations.name: Single with no delivery address: the country only
Multiple: the address of the shipping method the calculation was made for
Multiple, shipping method without an address: the first shipping method's address
